effect.simplymastery.snapback.descriptio: When the rite jumps targets, it creates a 3-block burst for 35% pulse damage.

effect.simplymastery.executioners_drop.d: The rite plunges after 3 seconds and deals 225% final plunge damage.

effect.simplymastery.tempered_flesh.desc: Brimstone Rite grants Fire Resistance through its duration and plunge.

effect.simplymastery.ashen_step.descript: Taking damage during the rite grants Speed I for 3 seconds, with a 5-second cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.bulwark_pulse.descr: A pulse hitting at least 3 enemies refreshes Absorption I for 3 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.walking_furnace.des: Brimstone Rite follows you with reduced radius, pulls enemies inward, and grants Resistance I.
effect.simplymastery.last_reprisal.descr: Falling to 35% health during the rite triggers an empowered early plunge and grants Absorption II and Resistance II.
